title: dam category list answer
description: What dam category list prints with -o. An exclusive category lets an object carry one of its values. Inside a project the project's categories come first, then yours in force, then yours set aside.

project.description: The category comes from the project's .dam.lua. Present only when true.

set_aside.description: Your category shares a name or a label with one of the project's, so it is not in force inside this project. Present only when true.
